text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
About two months left—until the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Ayabe-san says she's passing on 
the race. The reason is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I want to enter, but 3,200 meters is 
probably too long for me. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll be aiming for sure victories on a 
medium-distance-focused rotation. Our 
showdown will have to wait—just a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own race schedules, but 
things are finally about to get started.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Our Act Two—the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to win—against Ayabe-san, and Opera 
O-chan too. I want to run a race worthy of 
being called one of the Big Three.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's aim for even greater heights!

text_block_list.text:
Judging by last year's races, Narita Top 
Road is not falling behind the other two 
by any means.

This year, the key seemed to be just how 
far she could "pull away" from the pack.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, the Big Three, huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san, is something the matterrr?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, I just thought it had a lovely and 
nostalgic ring to it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Youth is unforgettable to anyone. We 
always wish to remain young and green. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The flow of time is cruel, you see. A time 
will come when we must part.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Between the true champion— and those who 
aren't.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first comes the preliminary 
clash. Let us show them the running style 
we have honed to perfection this year.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in the audience surely expects 
it: that Act II will be a story of light 
even more brilliant than last year's."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "A story of light...? Is that not right?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, unfortunately not. The start of the 
second act is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —A tragedy. A blood-chilling one, at that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A crushing victory for T.M. Opera O!! 
What is this overwhelming, absolute 
power...！？

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She completely pulled away from the entire 
field in an instant! A truly decisive 
victory! A flawless performance!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...

"Watching that run... I was lost for 
words... I only came to take a casual look 
at my rival's form, but—"

"Standing there was— an Umamusume I had 
never seen before."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! A long run in the rain was quite 
enjoyable too. Though, it was a tad 
lonely.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that no one could keep up with 
me. I really wished someone had been by my 
side to witness the radiance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The hour is upon us—the end of the 
century! Look up, everyone, look to the 
great sky!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Now, the sun is completely eclipsed. By a 
ruler far mightier than the sun itself."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That was one of those once called the Big 
Three. However, one cannot remain a serene 
prince forever."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Act Two begins now! The title of the 
prologue is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Birth of the Overlord of the End of the 
Century

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, all of you lords and nobles, face me 
all at once! I shall show you my 
earth-shattering power!

It was her usual grandiose acting. The 
only difference was—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She was strong last year, too. But... she 
never had this kind of strength that 
completely tramples over everything...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Her stamina and tenacity are on a 
whole different level. Trainer, just what 
on earth happened...?

Whether they did something special or it 
simply bloomed naturally, I cannot say. 
However...

It was certain that T.M. Opera O had shown 
a run levels above what she did last year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, but still! We don't know for 
sure yet if she's become completely out of 
our league.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan might've been in 
exceptionally good form today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... To be honest, I'm half in 
doubt myself...

To assess the true strength of her rivals— 
as a Trainer, there was only one thing I 
could do.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A mock race? Why, of course. I was just 
thinking about asking you for one myself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because we haven't even finished our "nice 
to meet you" greetings yet.

Hearing those words gave me a premonition 
bordering on certainty. Just as I 
thought...

It seems that overwhelming victory the 
other day wasn't just a matter of good 
form.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh...! Uuuggghhh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... No way... To think I couldn't 
pass either of them...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The gap was... ever so slight. But no 
matter how hard I chased, that tiny gap...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you. When it comes to running 
together, you two really are the best.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Comparing yourself to them makes it 
plainly obvious just how far I have 
evolved.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... A monster. I knew it... my eyes 
weren't playing tricks on me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So this is the current Opera O-chan... 
Completely different from last year...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't just keep standing still in 
the same place.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I want to reach no matter 
what. And besides—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The ones who urged me to awaken were Top 
Road-san and Ayabe-san—you two, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We……?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Last year's dazzling, fierce 
battle...! If we repeat a romance like 
that, even a Sleeping Beauty would surely 
open her eyes.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! And Top Road-san—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hope the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring) 
doesn't end up being our eternal, final 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I consider all of you quite fine actors, 
as well as trusted allies. —See you.

T.M. Opera O departed with eyes full of 
benevolence. That kindness—

"If anything, it was terrifying. It was an 
undeniable display of sheer confidence..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've been made keenly aware of 
that. However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I got to see how much Opera 
O-chan has changed before the real race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Just as Opera O-chan said, we might be the 
ones who awakened it. However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sooner or later, I think it would've come 
to this. That is Opera O-chan's true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To stand and face it... there's only one 
way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's start training, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There's no time left before the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Ayabe-san isn't running, so we 
can't even do joint long-distance training 
together...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I want to do everything I can. 
Even if it's just to close the gap by a 
single step...!"

âA shocking start. However, we can't 
stay overwhelmed forever.

Narita Top Road vs. T.M. Opera O. Their 
first G1 showdown of the year is now just 
around the corner.
